_README: Ingestion intake plan, re-derived 2026-09-11 from the delivered VBPL archive and the revised QA CSV. Every identity below was read off the document itself (born-digital header or tesseract OCR of the scan), never inferred from a filename. scripts/build_corpus_chunks.py reads this file; it fails loudly on any entry whose status is not skipped/blocked/quarantined but whose file is absent. Delivery convention: file lives at data/raw_legal/<expected_file>; when the PDF's embedded text layer is missing or corrupt the script falls back to data/raw_legal/ocr/<stem>.ocr.txt and stamps the chunk metadata with extraction=ocr:...
